title: Source index types
responsibility: Defines source graph, file facts and uncertainty data types.

outputs.name: SourceGraph
outputs.description: A source graph containing nodes, edges and uncertain references.

outputs.name: UncertainNode
outputs.description: Identifies origin/reason/detail only; it has no structured target candidates or owner.

outputs.name: GraphNode
outputs.description: Optional unit may identify owner; missing ownership is not proof of irrelevance.

outputs.name: GraphEdge
outputs.description: Direction and runtime classification require the graph producer contract.

outputs.name: ResolvedReference
outputs.description: path is repository-relative tracked source; external names an external package or runtime module.

outputs.name: SourceTree
outputs.description: May represent a working tree or exact commit; type alone does not prove committed provenance.

outputs.name: TreeEntry
outputs.description: A source tree listing entry containing its path and hash.
